question: How many days would it take to binge every episode of The Simpsons back to back?
explainer: By May 2025 there were 790 episodes of about 22 minutes: 290 hours, which is about 12 days without sleep.

question: How many days would it take to watch every Marvel Cinematic Universe film released up to 2023, back to back?
source_title: How long would it take to watch all 33 MCU movies (Fiction Horizon)
explainer: The first 33 MCU films run 4,359 minutes in total, about 72.7 hours: three full days and nights of superheroes.

question: Reading aloud, how many hours would it take to read all seven Harry Potter books?
source_title: How many words are in the Harry Potter books (Word Counter)
explainer: The seven books total 1,084,170 words. At 150 words a minute that is 7,228 minutes, about 120 hours of reading aloud.

question: At three and a half minutes a song, how many years would it take to listen to every track on Spotify?
explainer: Spotify has more than 100 million tracks. 100 million × 3.5 minutes is 5.8 million hours, about 670 years.

question: Reading at a normal pace, how many hours would it take to read everything Shakespeare wrote?
explainer: Shakespeare's complete works run to 884,647 words. At 250 a minute that is 3,539 minutes, about 59 hours.

question: How many Pokémon trading cards have been printed for every person on Earth?
explainer: The Pokémon Company had shipped 64.8 billion cards by March 2024. With 8.1 billion people, that is eight cards each.

question: How many days would it take to watch all 236 episodes of Friends back to back?
explainer: 236 episodes of about 22 minutes is 5,192 minutes, 87 hours: about three and a half days.

question: How many copies of the Mona Lisa, laid side by side, would it take to carpet a football pitch?
explainer: The Mona Lisa is 77 cm by 53 cm, 0.41 m². A pitch is about 7,140 m², so about 17,000 Mona Lisas.

question: How many Oscar statuettes would weigh the same as an African elephant?
source_title: The Oscar statuette (Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences)
explainer: An Oscar weighs 3.86 kg and a big elephant about 6,000 kg, so about 1,600 statuettes.

question: Watching non-stop for a week, how many times could you get through the extended Lord of the Rings trilogy?
source_title: The Lord of the Rings (film series) (Wikipedia)
explainer: The three extended films run about 11.4 hours together. A week is 168 hours, so about 15 times through.

question: How many years of non-stop listening do one billion Spotify streams of a typical song add up to?
explainer: A billion plays of 3.5 minutes is 3.5 billion minutes, 58 million hours, about 6,700 years of listening.

question: How many lattes could Taylor Swift's Eras Tour ticket sales have bought?
explainer: The Eras Tour grossed about $2.08 billion in ticket sales. At $5 a latte that is about 420 million coffees.

question: For every Harry Potter book ever sold, how many people are there on Earth?
explainer: More than 600 million Harry Potter books have been sold. With 8.1 billion people, that is one book for every 14 of us.

question: How many times has 'Baby Shark' been watched on YouTube for every person on Earth?
explainer: The Baby Shark Dance video passed 15 billion views. Divided by 8.1 billion people, that is nearly two views each.

question: If the Louvre's visitors for one year queued in single file, one metre apart, how many kilometres long would the queue be?
explainer: The Louvre had about 8.7 million visitors in 2024. One per metre makes a queue 8.7 million metres long: 8,700 km, Paris to Beijing.

question: How many hours of Simpsons would you have watched if you saw every episode the week it aired, from 1989 to 2025?
explainer: 790 episodes of 22 minutes is 17,380 minutes, which is about 290 hours: twelve full days of Springfield spread over 36 years.

question: If every Harry Potter book ever sold were stacked in one pile, how many kilometres tall would it be?
explainer: More than 600 million copies have been sold, each about 3 cm thick: 18 million metres, about 18,000 km, more than the Earth's diameter.

question: How many cinema tickets does Avatar's worldwide box office add up to?
explainer: Avatar (2009) has grossed about $2.92 billion worldwide. At $10 a ticket that is about 290 million tickets.

question: How many days of music are added to Spotify every single day?
source_title: Over 60,000 tracks are now uploaded to Spotify daily (Music Business Worldwide)
explainer: About 60,000 tracks are uploaded a day. At 3.5 minutes each that is 3,500 hours, about 150 days of music arriving every day.

question: How many episodes of The Simpsons could you watch in the time it takes to watch the extended Lord of the Rings trilogy?
source_title: The Lord of the Rings (film series) (Wikipedia)
explainer: The extended trilogy runs about 11.4 hours, 684 minutes. At 22 minutes an episode that is about 31 episodes.

question: How many sold-out Wembley Stadium concerts would it take to equal the Eras Tour's total attendance?
explainer: The Eras Tour drew 10,168,008 people over 149 shows. Wembley holds about 90,000, so about 110 sell-outs.

question: How many times has 'Baby Shark' been played on YouTube every second since it was uploaded in 2016?
explainer: The video passed 15 billion views in about eight years, which is 252 million seconds: about 59 plays every second, day and night.

question: How many Barbie dolls laid head to toe would it take to stretch from Los Angeles to New York?
explainer: Los Angeles to New York is about 3,944 km in a straight line, and a Barbie is 29 cm tall: about 14 million dolls.

question: How many Mount Everests tall would a single stack of every Pokémon card ever printed be?
explainer: 64.8 billion cards at 0.3 mm each is 19.4 million metres. Everest is 8,849 m, so about 2,200 Everests.
